feuquieres1691.summary: Feuquières acknowledges Catinat's letter of the 24th and sets out the plan for the surprise of Veillane (Avigliana): the enemy will not defend it seriously, he cannot see how to get the eighty horse to Sant'Ambrogio, and he will attack at two points and keep the dragoons from escaping. It matches Catinat's 'Mémoire pour l'entreprise de Veillane' of 19 Jan; printed in cipher in the 1819 Mémoires de Catinat, t. II pp. 283-284.

herleville1690.summary: Louvois tells d'Herleville, governor of Pignerol, that the King permits him to demand the contribution of the country of Mondovì and, if he sees fit, to exempt it and let the inhabitants raze the citadel, and awaits news of his enterprise on Villefranche. Printed in cipher with its contemporary 'traduction' in the 1819 Mémoires de Catinat, t. I pp. 140-142; the alignment of the two gave the key.

snip.cap: Mémoires de Catinat 1819, vol. II p. 283, the ciphered despatch
